title: Metabolic reaction-flux heatmap (reaction x timepoint, seed 0 gen 1)
interpretation: FBA base-reaction fluxes across the cell cycle, |flux| on a log10 color scale with reactions sorted by magnitude. Of 2820 base reactions ~699 carry nonzero flux, spanning ~4 decades (median active flux ~2e-3, max ~32 mmol/gDCW/h) — a handful of central-carbon reactions dominate, which on a linear scale washed the whole map to a flat ~0 field. The log scale + magnitude sort exposes the active band (top) vs the inactive reactions (flat band, bottom); fluxes are stable across the cycle (no flux collapse). x-axis in minutes.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
